Load and merge RNA count matrices of several samples

Source: R/progression_markers.R
load_and_merge_rna_counts.Rd

Reads one Seurat object per sample from file.path(data_dir, sample, file_name), extracts the raw counts of assay, prefixes cell IDs with "<sample>-" (unless already prefixed), keeps the genes common to all samples and column-binds the matrices.

Usage

load_and_merge_rna_counts(
  sample_names,
  data_dir,
  file_name = "wnn_rna_filtered.rds",
  assay = "rna"
)

Arguments

sample_names

Character vector of sample names (sub-directories of data_dir).

data_dir

Directory holding one sub-directory per sample.

file_name

Name of the Seurat .rds file inside each sample directory.

assay

Name of the RNA assay.

Value

A gene-by-cell count matrix (sparse, as stored in the objects).
